A NOTE ON THE HANDBOOK

How this version is scored

The conversation excerpt preserved these original quest values: Glycolic acid + moisturising (+10), dry brushing + body oil (+10), nourishment target (+20), posture & grace (+15), future-self scripting (+10), and Holy Hour (+15).

The excerpt also says the complete daily checklist totals 235 XP, Perfect Glow Day earns +50 XP, and a seven-day streak earns +100 XP. Other quest labels, level thresholds, Pearl conversion and rewards below are reconstructed defaults because the full handbook text wasn't available in the project mirror.

Quest XP is counted once per completion, per day. Pearl conversion uses quest XP only; milestone bonus XP does not mint extra Pearls. Bonuses are recorded once. Personal quests can add XP beyond the 235 XP core checklist. No missed day removes XP, Pearls or streak progress.
